pages.title: Read, Then Learn
pages.text: Distinguish reading a book from learning and equipping its actual combat skill.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find a skill-bearing book through normal adventures. Opening its screen is not learning: confirm the choice and inspect the skill slot. An empty book does not qualify.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Learn the recorded skill, then equip its allowed slot; book use alone opens a screen.
